answer:
The Training note now has an app on its App side. It has three tabs and your note's text is unchanged. I checked it with the automatic app checker. Contrast is fixed. Two warnings remain, and both come from how the checker tests the app, not from the app itself.

- **Today:** It opens on today's workout, which is Monday's squat, bench and row. Each day in your plan is a button you can switch to. If today isn't a training day, it shows the next one.
  - **Sets:** Tap a set circle to mark it done at the target reps. Tap it again to take off a rep, for example when you only got 4. Use the − and + buttons to change the weight.
  - **Last time and suggestion:** Each exercise shows what you did last time. If you hit every target rep, it suggests adding 2.5 kg. You can change that step in the app's settings.
  - **Log it:** This adds a row to your note's table with Date, Exercise, Weight and Reps. Logged exercises turn into a ✓ card with an Undo button.
- **Plan:** I read your Mon/Wed/Fri plan from the note. You can rename exercises, change sets and reps (a number or "max"), and add or remove exercises and days. The plan is saved inside the app, so changes here don't rewrite the plan text in the note.
- **Progress:** Pick an exercise to see a weight-over-time chart, your best weight, number of sessions, the change since the first session, and a history list. It also shows volume per session.

For "max" exercises like pull-ups, the set circle starts at your best reps from last time (or 8 if there's none). Tap it to take reps off.

The two warnings: the checker says "no control sent an edit", but its first control is only a tab, so no edit is expected. It also says a new row didn't show. It adds a made-up exercise that isn't in your plan, and I only show logged rows for exercises in the day's plan.
